# Grades and Callsigns
Every Company employee holds two identifiers: a [bold]paygrade[/bold], printed on the ID card and used for payroll, and an [bold]office callsign[/bold], used on faxes and internal correspondence. Use both correctly. Correspondence addressed to the wrong desk is answered late, or not at all.
## Writing a callsign A callsign is written [bold][Location] [Division][Job code]-[Seniority][/bold].
- [bold]Location[/bold]: [bold]Lower[/bold] for floors 1 to 30 of the Corporate Offices, [bold]Upper[/bold] for floor 31 and above. An Upper employee doesn't outrank a Lower employee with a higher job code. - [bold]Division[/bold]: the division number, 1 to 7. See [textlink="Divisions" link="CMUCorporateHandbookDivisions"/]. - [bold]Job code[/bold]: a letter from A to K. There is no E. - [bold]Seniority[/bold]: time in the same chair. [bold]-L[/bold] Lower, [bold]-M[/bold] Middle, [bold]-S[/bold] Senior.
Example: [bold]Upper 3B-M[/bold] is a Middle Communications Executive on the upper floors, paygrade WYC3. In the field, the location and seniority are usually dropped, leaving [bold]3B[/bold].
## The office grid Job codes are the same in every division. Only the division number changes. - [bold]Below grid[/bold], WYC1 Trainee (Trn.): probationary staff. No job code. - [bold]A[/bold], WYC2 Junior Executive (Jr. Exec.) - [bold]B[/bold], WYC3 Executive (Exec.) - [bold]C[/bold], WYC4 Senior Executive (Sr. Exec.) - [bold]D[/bold], WYC5 Executive Specialist (Exec. Spc.) - [bold]F[/bold], WYC6 Executive Supervisor (Exec. Spvsr.) - [bold]G[/bold], WYC7 Assistant Manager (Assis. Mng.) - [bold]H[/bold], WYC8 Division Manager (Div. Mng.) - [bold]I[/bold], WYC9 Chief Executive (Chief. Exec.) - [bold]J[/bold], WYC10 Deputy Director (Dep. Director) - [bold]K[/bold], WYC11 Director (Director)
Codes H and above are Company leadership and may keep a personal assistant. The assistant holds the same job code with the title of assistant.
Personal Protection (division 7) uses its own titles on the grid: 7A Trainee Officer, 7B Officer, 7C Senior Officer, 7D Specialist, 7F Coordinator, then 7G to 7K as the other divisions.
## Counsel Company counsel sit beside the grid at the D and F bands. They don't hold a division column. - [bold]WYC5L Legal Specialist[/bold] (L. Spc.) - [bold]WYC6L Legal Supervisor[/bold] (L. Spvsr.)
## Other Company grades - [bold]WYPO2 Captain[/bold] (Capt.): Company ship captain. Paid at the WYC2 band. Not on the office grid. - [bold]WYS1 Utility Synthetic[/bold] (U. Syn.): drivers, haulers, repair. - [bold]WYS2 Assistant Synthetic[/bold] (Assis. Syn.): secretarial, data and analysis work. - [bold]WYS3 Administrative Synthetic[/bold] (Adm. Syn.): project oversight, under organic supervision.
Synthetics are Company property. They're listed here for completeness.
## Posts at a colonial site - [bold]Office worker[/bold]: WYC1 to WYC4 by tenure. - [bold]Corporate Liaison[/bold]: Corporate Relations, WYC5 (2D), promoted to WYC6 (2F) with tenure. - [bold]Corporate Assistant[/bold]: WYC7 (G). - [bold]Division Manager[/bold]: WYC8, H in their claimed division. - [bold]Chief Executive[/bold]: WYC9 (I). - Deputy Directors and Directors aren't posted to colonial sites. If one visits, everybody is told in advance.
